events.name: Spirit in Nature: A Guided Meditation Walk at Wolbach Farm
events.location: Wolbach Farm, 18 Wolbach Road, Sudbury, MA
events.description: Interfaith meditative walk led by Rabbi Katy Allen on the accessible All Persons' Trail, with stops for poetry and reflection; co-sponsored by Sudbury Valley Trustees and JCAN-MA.

events.name: Light the Way: Energy Justice and the One Billion People Left Behind
events.description: Online session with JCAN-MA and SolarBuddy on how congregations can build and send small solar lights to families without reliable electricity.

projects.name: Sustainable Faith: An Interfaith Season of Creation Series
projects.description: Weekly series of essays from religious and ethical leaders across Massachusetts on how faith sustains their climate work, running through October 11, 2026.

projects.name: Climate Action Alerts
projects.description: Timely calls to action for people of faith when their voice matters at the State House and beyond.

actions.name: Congregations: take the MassIPL member pledge
actions.description: Houses of worship pledge to take at least one meaningful climate action each year (pray, act, mobilize) and join a network of 250+ member congregations.

actions.name: Start a congregational solar project before the federal direct-pay deadline
actions.description: MassIPL helps houses of worship use the federal direct-pay incentive, which can cover up to 40% of a solar project; projects must be running by December 31, 2027.

events.name: ACE Youth Innovation Summit
events.location: First Parish Dorchester, 10 Parish Street, Dorchester, MA 02122
events.description: Free community event celebrating young people's work in their neighborhoods, with workshops, activities, music, AC unit registration, college readiness sessions and backpack giveaways.

projects.name: Environmental Justice Assistance Network (EJAN)
projects.description: Pro bono network that matches community groups facing environmental justice and public health problems with volunteer experts in law, science, planning and public health.

projects.name: ACE Policy Agenda 2025-26
projects.description: ACE's legislative and policy priorities for the 2025-2026 session.

actions.name: Volunteer your professional skills with EJAN
actions.description: Attorneys, licensed site professionals, planners, scientists, public health and other professionals can volunteer to support community groups facing environmental justice problems.

actions.name: Join ACE as a member or volunteer
actions.description: Sign up to become an ACE member or volunteer with its Roxbury-based organizing work.

fields.description: Massachusetts chapter of the national Elders Climate Action, a volunteer group of older adults who educate and organize in their communities, advocate for state climate legislation and work with allied groups.

events.name: ECA Mass Monthly Chapter Meeting
events.recurrence: Second Tuesday of each month, 12–2 PM
events.description: Regular chapter meeting on Zoom; registration is required to get the meeting link.

events.name: ECA Mass Deep Dialogue
events.description: Session of the chapter's Deep Dialogue conversation series on Zoom; registration required.

projects.name: Deep Dialogues and Expert Series
projects.description: Recurring online conversation series with speakers on climate topics; recordings are posted on the chapter website.

actions.name: Join an ECA Mass team
actions.description: Volunteer with one of the chapter's teams, such as Action Planning (lobbying and protests), Legislative (bill tracking and testimony), Research, or Presentation and Education.

notes: andover_high_school_environmental_club: website is the club's chapter profile on Project Green Schools (no own site or social found); the profile is undated so no last_activity. projectgreenschools.org shows a bot challenge to curl; read via WebFetch. alternatives_for_community_and_environment: ace-ej.org shows a SiteGround captcha to curl; pages were read via WebFetch. ma_youth_for_climate_justice: only public presence found is Instagram (@mayouth4climatejustice) and a Facebook page; both block automated readers, so website comes from search results only and no description/focus/date could be verified. Consider a manual check. elders_climate_action_mass: type left blank (site says it is a volunteer chapter of national ECA; no tax status shown). ecamass.org intermittently shows a SiteGround captcha; some pages read via WebFetch. Its event calendar also lists other groups' meetings; only ECA Mass's own were recorded. An Oct 19 'Is Nuclear Power the Answer?' calendar entry repeats May text and was skipped as unreliable. mit_sea: no MIT group named 'Students for Environmental Action' found on MIT sustainability pages or the MIT Student Sustainability Coalition member list (ssc.mit.edu/?p=7). The only 'MIT SEA' there is the Sustainable Energy Alliance, a different undergraduate energy club (facebook.com/mitsea) - the entry may be mislabelled; worth asking MYCC which group is meant.
